author: Jorge Fernandez Mendez

steps.title: Centrifuge Latex Bead Aliquots
steps.instruction: Centrifuge four different 40 μL aliquots of 2.5 %wt. latex bead stock suspension at 15,000 rpm for 3 minutes, then slowly remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Apply Beads to Nitrocellulose Membrane
steps.instruction: Wait 10 minutes, then pipette 10 μL of each bead suspension onto a piece of nitrocellulose membrane, ensuring drops are separated by at least 8 mm.

steps.title: Analyze Bead Migration
steps.instruction: Wait until the deposited sample has migrated completely, then circle the outline of the sample eluted front on the plastic backing of the nitrocellulose membrane to observe bead retention.

steps.title: Resuspend Beads in Distilled Water
steps.instruction: Repeat the centrifugation and membrane application process, but resuspend all beads in distilled water instead of the original stock.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 10 μL of resuspended beads onto nitrocellulose membrane (Step 2)

steps.title: Analyze Resuspended Bead Migration
steps.instruction: Repeat the migration analysis and circling of the eluted front for the resuspended bead stocks.
